purpose: Fresh benchmark demonstrations for a neural starting policy, followed by separately accounted PPO improvement.
checkpoint_selection: Fixed final supervised epoch; validation does not select epochs.
rl_contribution_requirement: Compare PPO after additional RL against its own behavior-cloned starting policy, and retain demonstration-only and fixed classical baselines.
resource_policy: One sequential collection process; two existing coordinators remain unchanged. Maximum four concurrent simulator processes.
limitations: Teacher labels use privileged simulator information; the deployed student receives local observations only.
Behavior cloning alone is not a reinforcement-learning contribution.
Action-prediction error is not safety performance; closed-loop evaluation is required.
Demonstrations sample teacher trajectories; covariate shift is possible.
